summary: Open-source apps to run Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents and keep working from your phone, with end-to-end encryption.

heroCommands.command: iOS, Android and desktop from happy.engineering

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Happy lets you run AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Gemini (through Antigravity) and follow or steer the same sessions from your phone. You sign in with the subscriptions you already have, so it adds no extra bill. This repository holds the iOS, Android and web apps, the original Happy CLI and the relay server for encrypted sync; the desktop app lives in a separate repo.
sixtySeconds.problem: Coding agents run in a terminal at your desk. Happy lets you check on them and give instructions from your phone, and share a session with someone else.
whoFor: Developers using Claude Code or Codex
People who want to steer agents away from their desk
Pairs who want to watch one agent together
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it to take your existing agent sessions mobile, with encryption and without paying for another service.
requirements: Node.js with npm for the CLI
Claude Code or Codex set up with your own account

overview: Install the original CLI with npm install -g happy.
Start a session with happy claude or happy codex, then continue from the iOS or Android app.
For multi-model sessions and teams, the README recommends the desktop app. It is MIT licensed.
